goal: Dependency gate: known-vulnerable or unmaintained packages blocked from a merge.
use: Dependency gate: known-vulnerable or unmaintained packages blocked from a merge. Use when a change adds or upgrades a dependency.

steps.note: Confirm the check runs on each change that touches a lock file.
Set the rule. A new dependency with a known high or critical advisory blocks the merge.
Check unmaintained packages. Flag packages with no release in a long period.
Check exceptions. Each allowed exception needs an owner and an expiry.
Report. Each blocked or flagged package with its advisory and the decision.
